segments.source: Hare met Elephant carrying a pot of honey.
Elephant carried Hare on his back.
They found a big buffalo drinking water in a river.
Hare wanted to know who was stronger, Buffalo or Elephant.
Hare said he had an idea how to find out.
Hare tied one end of a rope around Elephant’s waist.
Hare tied the other end around Buffalo’s waist.
Hare hid in a tree and shouted, “Pull!â€
Hare cut the rope, closer to Buffalo.
Hare praised Buffalo saying, “You are stronger.â€
